title: Operation Watermelon

concept.story: Milo leads a spy-style heist to grab a giant watermelon from the farm picnic table. Bruno blows their cover, Rocky takes over to 'show the professionals' and knocks the watermelon off the table, and Chiku panics as it rolls away. It cracks open right in front of Ducky, who thanks everyone for the delivery.
concept.hook: Extreme close-up of Milo in sunglasses peeking over a hay bale, whispering the mission name.
concept.comedy_moment: Rocky's cool strut ends with his sunglasses slipping and a gentle bump that sends the watermelon rolling across the yard.
concept.punchline: The watermelon cracks open at Ducky's feet: 'Thanks for the delivery!' Milo slowly lowers his sunglasses in disbelief.
concept.viral_notes: Heist parody that reads instantly, visual twist that works on mute, and a loopable ending (Milo's stare leads back into his opening whisper).

music.brief: Light comedic 'sneaky spy' pizzicato loop for clips 1-2, a quick rise for clip 3, a stop-down beat on the punchline, then a tiny comedic sting under the Milo stare.
music.source_rule: Royalty-free only (YouTube Audio Library, or a track you own). Never commercial songs.

image.action: Milo peeks over the top of a golden hay bale in the foreground, only his head, paws and the top of his red hoodie visible, leaning toward the camera conspiratorially. Bruno sits just behind Milo's right shoulder, head poking up beside him, ears perked, tongue slightly out.

expressions.milo: narrowed eyes behind the sunglasses, serious secret-agent face, one eyebrow raised
expressions.bruno: wide innocent eyes, excited and eager

image.environment: farmyard at golden hour; out of focus in the background, a wooden picnic table with one giant green striped watermelon on it, red barn behind
image.lighting: warm low golden-hour sunlight from the left, soft rim light on fur, gentle lens bloom
image.camera: eye-level with the animals, 50mm lens, extreme close-up on Milo with Bruno slightly behind
image.composition: Milo's face in the upper third centre, Bruno right of frame, the watermelon a soft shape in the deep background top-left

video.start: Milo peeking over the hay bale, Bruno beside him
video.motion: Milo slowly turns his head toward camera and leans in to whisper; Bruno bounces up excitedly and shouts with his tail wagging; Milo snaps his head toward Bruno and raises one paw to his mouth to shush him
video.environment_motion: hay strands drifting in the breeze, dust motes in the sunlight
video.end: Milo frozen mid-shush, glaring at Bruno; Bruno ears down, sheepish
video.sfx: soft rustling hay, a distant rooster cluck, a quiet breeze

image.action: Rocky stands confidently in the open grass in the foreground, chest out, chin up, mid-stride as if he just stepped into frame. Milo peeks from behind the hay bale on the left edge in the background.
image.environment: same sunny farmyard; the wooden picnic table with the giant watermelon clearly visible in the mid-ground behind Rocky
image.lighting: warm golden-hour sunlight from the left, long soft shadows on the grass
image.camera: low angle from grass level, 35mm lens, medium-full shot making Rocky look heroic
image.composition: Rocky centre frame, the watermelon table above his right shoulder, Milo small on the left behind the hay bale

video.start: Rocky standing proudly, Milo peeking in the background
video.motion: Rocky turns his head toward Milo and speaks, then struts in slow motion toward the picnic table with exaggerated swagger, his gold chain swinging; in the background Milo slowly turns his face to the camera with a deadpan look
video.camera_move: slow tracking shot following Rocky from behind as he walks toward the table
video.environment_motion: grass swaying, butterflies in the background
video.end: Rocky arriving next to the picnic table, watermelon at his eye level
video.sfx: confident hoof steps on grass, gold chain clinking

dialogue.speaker: rocky
dialogue.line: Step aside, amateurs. Watch a professional.

image.action: Rocky stands right beside the wooden picnic table, head tilted in a 'cool' pose, his sunglasses sliding down his nose. The giant green striped watermelon sits on the edge of the table next to him. Chiku stands on top of the wooden fence in the background.
image.environment: the picnic table on a gentle grassy slope that runs down toward a small pond area
image.lighting: bright warm afternoon sun, crisp shadows
image.composition: table and Rocky in the left half, open sloping grass to the right for the roll, Chiku on the fence top-right

video.start: Rocky posing next to the table, watermelon at the table edge
video.motion: Rocky flicks his head in a cool pose, his sunglasses slip down his nose and he leans to catch them, gently nudging the table with his shoulder; the watermelon wobbles, drops softly onto the grass and starts rolling down the slope; Rocky freezes with an open-mouthed stare; on the fence Chiku flaps his wings wildly and screams
video.camera_move: quick pan right following the rolling watermelon
video.environment_motion: grass parting as the watermelon rolls
video.end: watermelon rolling away down the slope, Chiku mid-scream on the fence
video.sfx: wooden table bump, soft thud, rolling rumble on grass, frantic wing flaps

image.action: Ducky lounges relaxed in the soft grass at the bottom of the slope next to a small smooth rock, wings resting behind his head like a sunbather. The giant watermelon is rolling toward him from the upper left.

expressions.ducky: relaxed, eyes closed behind sunglasses, carefree

image.environment: bottom of the grassy slope near a little pond with reeds, wildflowers around
image.lighting: warm afternoon sun, soft highlights on white feathers
image.camera: low angle at grass level, 35mm lens, medium shot
image.composition: Ducky in the lower right third, the rock in front of him, the watermelon entering from the upper left

video.start: Ducky lounging, watermelon rolling in from upper left
video.motion: the watermelon rolls into the small rock and cracks open neatly into two halves showing bright red flesh, right in front of Ducky; Ducky slowly lowers his sunglasses, looks at the watermelon, grins widely and speaks happily, then takes a little peck of the red fruit
video.environment_motion: reeds swaying, a little splash of watermelon juice
video.end: Ducky happily nibbling the watermelon half
video.sfx: satisfying crack of watermelon, juicy crunch, happy quack

image.action: Milo and Bruno stand side by side at the top of the slope looking down toward the camera, Milo in front.
image.environment: top of the grassy slope, picnic table behind them with nothing on it
image.composition: Milo centre, Bruno just behind to the right

video.motion: Milo very slowly lowers his sunglasses with one paw and stares straight into the camera without blinking; Bruno tilts his head and asks his question
video.camera_move: fast dramatic zoom-in on Milo's face
video.end: extreme close-up of Milo's deadpan eyes
video.sfx: a single cricket chirp in the silence

edit.transitions: hard cuts only; a 4-frame white flash before scene 4 to sell the crack
edit.zoom_effects: Driven by each scene's 'punch' list: [start, end, zoom] in clip seconds
edit.captions: word-chunked, white bold with black outline, centred in the lower-middle safe area (Shorts UI-safe), the punchline line in yellow
edit.punchline_emphasis: duck the music to silence for 0.5s before 'Thanks for the delivery!'
